flight.air_angle_basis: body velocity minus recorded total NED wind (background wind plus sampled turbulence), rotated into body axes
flight.energy_note: specific mechanical-energy proxy = g*altitude + 0.5*speed^2 (m^2/s^2); excludes fuel, engine and thermal energy
flight.speed_basis: speed_mps is the norm of the body state velocity (world ground trajectory); tas_mps and alpha/beta use air-relative velocity

trajectory.interpretation: Body q integral is descriptive. The independent path metric unwraps atan2(-world-down velocity, velocity along the initial vertical plane); cross-track distance and velocity describe plane departure. None alone proves a completed loop.
